name: Mitten Extracts Disposable | Strawberry Ice
description: Bursting with candy-sweet strawberry flavor and layered with a cool iced finish, Strawberry Ice is as refreshing as it is delicious. Smooth, fruity pulls melt into an icy exhale that keeps the profile balanced and uplifting. This limited-edition 2g disposable delivers a mellow, feel-good high paired with a flavor that’s crisp, sweet, and impossible to put down. A perfect pick for flavor chasers and fans of chilled, fruity profiles.
